project.description: Angular application project to configure. Defaults to the only application in the workspace.

path.description: Component directory relative to the selected application's src/app (for example pages/game).

routePath.description: Literal lazy route path for the sample scene (for example game).

route.description: Add a lazy route for the generated sample scene.

physics.description: Optionally install Jolt and configure its browser bundling. The sample remains a core scene; import triangular-engine/jolt for physics scenes.
